steps.content: [Underground Area]

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Ugh, come on, come on, COME ON!! These things are way too tough! And they just keep coming!
After leaving the underground maze, the group makes a swift advance toward the core laboratory, only to be cut off at the entrance by another squad of heavily armed Aurum Secretum guards.
Hella whips her water pipe in a wide arc, striking one guard with a deafening clang—its head flies clean off. Yet the headless body only staggers, rights itself, and lunges at her again.
Horo steps in, her axe flashing down in a single brutal strike. This time, the body crumples, motionless at last.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: They're not living things, after all. But good thing we can still put them down—
No sooner does she speak than two massive Aurum Secretum guards emerge at the far end of the corridor, their armored frames dwarfing the ones before.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: Dammit! These guys aren't going down easy...! Hey, Hella, time to use <color=#fb9259>that thing</color>!

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: I've modified Hella's communicator with a special function. Once destroyed, it will emit a pulse disabling all Aurum Secretum receivers within twenty meters. Use it when necessary.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Yeah... right...
Hella strokes the communicator in her hand, visibly struggling with herself, unable to bring herself to crush it.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: What? You really can't bear to let it go?

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: ...My bad. I owe you one. I'll get you a new one when we get back to Syndicate.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Sniffle...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: I-it's just a communicator, not some priceless treasure... Let's do it!
Gritting her teeth, Hella tears the communicator from her neck and hurls it to the ground with all her strength!
With a sharp crack of its shell breaking, a shockwave of golden light erupts, surging outward. The guards caught in the blast seize up, collapsing in twitching heaps.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: You bastards! I'm coming for your boss next and settling ALL scores!!
With that final curse, Hella whirls around and storms through the main door.
At the testing site, Synex stands shackled at the center of the space, the Mania on her seething with such ferocity that the very air around her seems to tremble.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Hey, Synex! Can you hear me?! Ugh—

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: ——
The next moment, Synex explodes forward with feral intensity. Hella barely twists aside to dodge her attack. And then she sees it:
Runic brands flicker to life across Synex's skin.
